articles.content: Steven Spielberg has directed musicals, sci-fi epics, adventure films, and biopics, but one genre has eluded him over the course of his decades-long career. He has never directed a Western, despite having openly longed to put his spin on the type of movies that turned one of his idols, John Ford, into a legend. Well, the wait is over. The incident, which aired on Sunday evening, saw Odudu, the host of “Big Brother,” clashing with fellow contestant Frostrup over cooking duties in the camp. articles.title: Antoine Fuqua Accused of Pointing Handgun, Using Antisemitic Slur in Assault Lawsuit
articles.summary: A spokesperson for the director denied the allegations and said, "It's not true."
articles.content: Director Antoine Fuqua has been sued for assault and battery by a bar manager, who alleges the director struck him with a handgun and used an antisemitic slur. In a lawsuit filed on Friday in California state court, the bar manager, William Rosenthal, details an altercation in February in which Fuqua and his group were denied entry to a Los Angeles bar because they were overly intoxicated. He claims the director “directed a racial and antisemitic slur” at him before the filmmaker and his son “pointed their handguns” in his direction. Related Stories Business Selena Gomez's Wondermind Fraud Lawsuit Has Been Dismissed With Prejudice TV Chris Pratt Seeks Violent Redemption in 'The Terminal List' Season 2 First-Look Images Rosenthal brings claims for assault, battery and intentional infliction of emotional distress. He seeks at least $50,000. In a statement, a spokesperson for the director denied the allegations. “It’s not true,” the representative said. The lawsuit says Fuqua and four others, including his daughter and son, visited Good Times at Davey Wayne’s in Los Angeles on Feb. 14. After the group was refused entry by Rosenthal, he was spat on by a member of the group and threatened by Fuqua’s daughter, according to the complaint. They left the establishment, the lawsuit says. Roughly an hour later, Fuqua returned and confronted Rosenthal about pepper spraying his daughter. Rosenthal denied the accusation and was hit in the face with a handgun by the director, who later used an antisemitic slur and threatened to kill the bar manager. From there, the altercation escalated, with Fuqua’s son also pulling out a handgun and striking Rosenthal, the lawsuit says. Rosenthal says he sustained a head injury, nose fracture and lacerations from the alleged assault and now has post-traumatic stress disorder and severe emotional stress. His lawyers say the injuries will result in “some permanent disability.”

articles.title: Sadie Sandler to Star in Netflix Horror Movie ‘Malibu’ From Vertigo, Happy Madison (Exclusive)
articles.summary: Room 101 also produces director Tod "Kip" Williams' feature about a dog-sitting gig gone wrong.
articles.content: Sadie Sandler is set to make a splash as she prepares to star in her first horror movie. The actress, who recently led the Netflix comedy Roommates , will collaborate again with the streamer on the horror feature Malibu , The Hollywood Reporter has learned. Tod “Kip” Williams, known for helming Paranormal Activity 2 , is set to direct the film from a script he wrote with Tom Pabst, who worked on the superhero series Titans . Production will begin in early 2027 for the feature that counts Roy Lee ‘s Vertigo Entertainment , Steven Schneider’s Room 101 and Adam Sandler ‘s Happy Madison as producers. Malibu centers on Sadie Sandler as an aspiring actress who accepts a last-minute dog-sitting job at a reclusive movie star’s Malibu mansion. Soon, she learns that the house is not what she expected. While Sandler appeared in Netflix’s 2020 spooky comedy Hubie Halloween opposite dad Adam Sandler and has voiced a role in Sony Pictures’ animated Hotel Transylvania franchise, Malibu is described as straight horror and is said to carry a much different tone from her previous projects. Sadie Sandler recently appeared on Netflix’s Nobody Wants This , and her feature credits include Roommates , Jay Kelly , Happy Gilmore 2 and You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah . In addition to helming Paranormal Activity 2 , Williams directed John Cusack and Samuel L. Jackson in the 2016 movie Cell that adapted Stephen King’s sci-fi horror novel. Lee, who was named THR’ s producer of the year in 2025, has served as executive producer on such horror series as Peacock’s Crystal Lake and HBO’s It: Welcome to Derry . His recent feature credits include Resident Evil , Weapons , A Minecraft Movie and Obsession director Curry Barker’s forthcoming movie Anything but Ghosts .

articles.content: Sheila Mangubat, who starred on season six of the TLC reality series 90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days , has died. She was 35. David Dangerfield, Mangubat’s former fiancé, shared on Instagram that she died on Saturday in the Philippines. Please keep her son, her family, and me in your prayers. Mangubat and Dangerfield’s relationship was documented on Before the 90 Days season six in 2023. After meeting through a Facebook group for deaf and hearing-impaired singles in 2021, Dangerfield traveled from Nebraska to the Philippines to meet his then-girlfriend Mangubat in person for the first time. articles.content: NBC will air a documentary special following the Princess of Wales as she completes a charity challenge to raise money for cancer patients. Heal will explore “life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness,” a description reads. Cameras followed Catherine as she completed the Three Peaks Challenge — climbing the tallest mountains in England, Scotland and Wales in the course of 24 hours — in June in support of the Royal Marsden Cancer Charity. It will also feature the stories of other people facing cancer (the princess was diagnosed with a form of cancer in 2024 but was in remission as of 2025). “[Cancer] changes your body, it changes you physically,” Catherine says in a trailer for the special (watch it below). “But there’s a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you.” All money from distribution of the special (it will also air in Australia on Dec. 1 and Canada on Dec. 7) will go to the Royal Marsden Cancer Charity to help people living with and after a cancer diagnosis. articles.summary: Director Andrey Zvyagintsev tells IndieWire about using sound to have the world crash in on its main character.
articles.content: Director Andrey Zvyagintsev has worked with supervising re-recording mixer Andrey Dergachev for 20 years, since the director’s second film , “Banishment.” On each project, including their most recent portrait of a rotten marriage in a rotten world, “ Minotaur ,” they’ve tried to improve the sound design—using it as a hook that makes the film’s world feel more vital and alive for the audience. Seriously, spoilers . This is never more true than in the absurdly sad and funny, then suddenly murderous confrontation between cuckolded husband Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) and his wife’s lover Anton (Yuriy Zavalnyouk) at the hinge point of “Minotaur.” Related Stories Super Bowl LXI to Play Live on IMAX Screens ‘Cliff Booth’ Star Elizabeth Debicki on Slapping Brad Pitt, ‘The Movie Critic,’ and the Rom-Com Question Zvyagintsev and Dergachev generally strive to preserve as much authentic production sound from performances as possible. “On my third movie, ‘Elena,’ we recorded the live sound from shooting, and it’s maybe two or three phrases we had to rerecord, but otherwise the whole sound that you hear is fully recorded during the shooting,” Zvyagintsev told IndieWire on an upcoming episode of the Filmmaker Toolkit podcast . “Our main purpose is to keep as much sound from the shooting as possible and not to add anything extra, and it was the same for ‘Minotaur.’” But for the moment that Gleb attacks Anton, and its aftermath, it was important to Zvyagintsev that the world beyond the apartment start intruding on Gleb — that even though he wants desperately to cover up what he’s done and make sure no one sees or learns about it, we hear dozens of ways in which he isn’t alone. articles.title: Super Bowl LXI to Play Live on IMAX Screens
articles.summary: IMAX is partnering with the NFL, ESPN, and Disney to screen the big game in North America, Australia, New Zealand, and Brazil.
articles.content: Super Bowl LXI is set to play live on IMAX screens across North America, as well as in some international markets, specifically Australia, New Zealand, and Brazil. The game takes place on Sunday, February 14, 2027, or Valentine’s Day 2027, and now you can convince your partner that the Valentine’s Day date night is still alive because you can go out to the movie theater to watch the game instead of stay at home. IMAX will screen everything from the pregame and postgame coverage, the full four-hour presentation of the game itself, and of course the Halftime Show headlined by Jay-Z, all beginning at 6 pm ET. ESPN’s Monday Night Football broadcast team of Joe Buck, Troy Aikman, Lisa Salters, and Laura Rutledge will be the ones you hear in the theater, so no luck if you’re a Peyton and Eli or Pat McAfee fan. The only thing we don’t know is who’s playing in the game just yet, but this Chicago Bears fan is feeling pretty good about his team’s chances. Specific theater locations and ticketing information will be announced in the coming weeks. This is the first time IMAX is screening something as big as the Super Bowl, but it’s not the first time IMAX has played live sporting events in its theaters. IMAX also screened the opening ceremony for the Paris Olympics, it this year did a series of F1 races in partnership with Apple TV, and events like NHL games and even the NBA Finals have played internationally. This is on a much bigger scale as well, as this will be available in hundreds of IMAX screens across the country. articles.title: Shawn Levy and 21 Laps Set Overall Film Deal at Sony Pictures
articles.summary: The "Star Wars: Starfighter" director reunites with Sony's leadership after directing the "Night at the Museum" movies, "Cheaper by the Dozen," and "Date Night."
articles.content: Sony Pictures has won the services to one of the most in-demand commercial directors working today, Shawn Levy . Levy and his 21 Laps banner have signed a major first look overall film deal with Sony Pictures, with Sony beating out multiple studios in what’s said to be a competitive process. Levy will develop and produce theatrical films through the 21 Laps Entertainment banner as part of the deal, which begins fall 2027 and extends across all Sony Pictures labels, so presumably that could include labels like Screen Gems or even Sony Animation. It’s a producing deal, not for directing, but we wouldn’t be surprised if that ends up being the case with one that his team brings in. articles.summary: It took three years longer to make "Meet the Parents 4" than it did to make "Grand Theft Auto VI," but (weirdly) it's somehow not quite as good.
articles.content: The world may not have been champing at the bit for another “ Meet the Parents ” sequel with quite the same enthusiasm that defined the hype for “GTA VI” (pretty close, tho!), but anyone who’s been itching for another crazaaaazy weekend between neurotic nurse Gaylord “Greg” Focker and his imperious ex-CIA father-in-law Jack Byrnes has had to wait even longer for their prayers to be answered. Was it worth it? Well, let’s do a quick comparison between two cultural phenomenons that I’m definitely not just lumping together in a desperate — some might say “heroic” — attempt to write an involving review lede for a movie that never makes even the slightest effort to earn your attention.
